title: Step 1 in R - Understanding Principal Component Analysis for Feature Extraction

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this art tutorial and welcome to Part nine Dimensionality Reduction.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學，也歡迎進入第九部分，降維。

cues.en: So we are starting this part with our first technique of dimensionality reduction which is, PCA, principle component analysis.
cues.zh: 這個部分先從第一種降維技術，PCA，也就是主成分分析開始。

cues.en: And so you know in dimensionality reduction there are two techniques, feature selection, and feature extraction.
cues.zh: 降維有兩種做法：特徵選取與特徵擷取。

cues.en: We did feature selection in part two, when we implemented the backward elimination model to select the most relevant features of our matrix of features.
cues.zh: 第二部分實作向後淘汰模型時，做過特徵選取，從特徵矩陣挑出最相關的特徵。

cues.en: That is the features that explain the most the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 也就是最能解釋依變數的特徵。

cues.en: And now we are starting this new technique of dimensionality reduction, which is feature extraction.
cues.zh: 現在開始另一種降維技術，也就是特徵擷取。

cues.en: And PCA principle component analysis, is one feature extraction technique.
cues.zh: PCA 主成分分析，就是一種特徵擷取技術。

cues.en: So as reminder, let's say your matrix of features, has M independent variables.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，假設特徵矩陣有 M 個自變數。

cues.en: Well, what PCA will do is that it will extract a smaller number of your independent variables, but there are going to be new independent variables like new dimensions.
cues.zh: PCA 會擷取較少數量的自變數，但它們是新的自變數，就像新的維度。

cues.en: And these new independent variables extracted are going to be some new independent variables that explain the most, the variants of your dataset.
cues.zh: 這些新擷取的自變數，會盡可能解釋資料集的變異。

cues.en: And that is regardless of your dependent variable.
cues.zh: 而這與依變數無關。

cues.en: And that makes PCA an unsupervised model in the sense that we don't consider the dependent variable in the model.
cues.zh: 這讓 PCA 成為非監督式模型，因為模型不考慮依變數。

cues.en: So that's PCA.
cues.zh: 這就是 PCA。

cues.en: And remember in part two and part three, we worked with one or two independent variables.
cues.zh: 記得第二、第三部分，只處理一個或兩個自變數。

cues.en: Well, that was for two specific purposes.
cues.zh: 那有兩個特定目的。

cues.en: The first purpose is that we needed a graphic visualization of our results.
cues.zh: 第一，我們需要用圖形將結果視覺化。

cues.en: And since each independent variable corresponded to one dimension in the blood while we could visualize our results with at most two independent variables.
cues.zh: 因為每個自變數對應圖中的一個維度，所以最多使用兩個自變數來呈現結果。

cues.en: And the second reason is that thanks to this PCA dimensionality reduction technique, well even if we have a lot of independent variables at the beginning
cues.zh: 第二，有了 PCA 這種降維技術，即使一開始有很多自變數，

cues.en: well we can end up with much less independent variables but that are going to be relevant independent variables because these independent variables will explain
cues.zh: 最後也能大幅減少，而且留下的新自變數仍然重要，因為它們能解釋

cues.en: the most, the variants of your data set.
cues.zh: 資料集中最多的變異。

cues.en: And therefore, since we can reduce this number of independent variables, well we can end up with two or three independent variables and therefore visualize the results as we did in part three.
cues.zh: 因此減少自變數數量後，就能得到兩個或三個自變數，像第三部分那樣視覺化結果。

cues.en: And this is exactly what we're going to do in this tutorial in the following tutorials of this section and the following sections when we cover other dimensionality reduction techniques, like LDA
cues.zh: 這正是這堂課、本節接下來的課程，以及後續介紹其他降維技術，例如 LDA

cues.en: and also Kernel PCA.
cues.zh: 與核 PCA 時，要做的事情。

cues.en: Well, we will have many features at the beginning and therefore it'll be impossible to visualize the results.
cues.zh: 一開始有很多特徵，所以無法將結果直接視覺化。

cues.en: But then when we apply PCA or LDA, we will reduce the number of features down to two and therefore we'll be able to visualize the results.
cues.zh: 套用 PCA 或 LDA 後，將特徵數降為兩個，就能視覺化結果。

cues.en: So let's start right now and let's start by setting the right folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 現在開始，先將正確資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: So as usual, we go to our machine learning, A to Z folder, then part nine, dimensionality reduction.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，進入 Machine Learning A-Z 資料夾，再進入 Part 9，Dimensionality Reduction。

cues.en: And here we are in the first section of this part nine, principle component analysis, that's our first technique.
cues.zh: 這是第九部分的第一節，Principal Component Analysis，也就是第一種技術。

cues.en: Let's click on it.
cues.zh: 點進去。

cues.en: And that's the folder we want to set as working directory.
cues.zh: 這就是要設為工作目錄的資料夾。

cues.en: Make sure that you have the one dot csv file.
cues.zh: 確認有 Wine.csv 檔案。

cues.en: And if that's the case, you're ready to click on this more button here, to set this folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 有的話，就按這裡的 More，將資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now we are going to open another file that we made in part three classification, which is our logistic regression dot R file.
cues.zh: 現在開啟第三部分分類時做的另一份檔案，也就是 logistic_regression.R。

cues.en: Because what we're going to do is take this logistic regression code, then we are going to change the name of the data set because we will be working on a new data set, which will be the one dot CSV file.
cues.zh: 因為要取用邏輯斯迴歸程式碼，再修改資料集名稱，這次使用新的 Wine.csv 資料集。

cues.en: And we will apply PCA on this data set.
cues.zh: 然後對它套用 PCA。

cues.en: And of course, I will explain quickly the business problem behind it.
cues.zh: 當然，也會快速解釋背後的商業問題。

cues.en: So I'm going to take everything from here down to the bottom.
cues.zh: 將這裡到底部的全部內容取出。

cues.en: Here we go, copy.
cues.zh: 複製。

cues.en: And I'm going to paste that in my PCA dot R file, this way.
cues.zh: 貼到 pca.R 檔案裡，像這樣。

cues.en: So let's go up and let's change the name of the data set.
cues.zh: 往上捲，修改資料集名稱。

cues.en: This is not social network at CSV, this is now one dot CSV.
cues.zh: 不再是 Social_Network_Ads.csv，現在是 Wine.csv。

cues.en: That's perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So now what we're going to do is first import this data set and then apply data pre-processing.
cues.zh: 現在先匯入資料集，再進行資料前處理。

cues.en: Maybe we'll need to change some things like the indexes here, but this will be very quick.
cues.zh: 也許需要修改這裡的索引之類的內容，但很快就能完成。

cues.en: So first, let's import the data set.
cues.zh: 先匯入資料集。

cues.en: So I'm going to select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這行並執行。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: The data set is well imported, here it is.
cues.zh: 資料集已正確匯入，就在這裡。

cues.en: And now let's expand the business problem behind it.
cues.zh: 接著說明背後的商業問題。

cues.en: Okay, so first of all this is a very famous data set well known in the machine learning literature and that you can find on the UCI machine learning repository, as you can see here.
cues.zh: 首先，這是機器學習文獻中非常知名的資料集，可以在 UCI 機器學習資料庫找到，如這裡所示。

cues.en: And you can find this page at this link.
cues.zh: 這個連結可以找到該頁面。

cues.en: So basically first, what are the independent variables and what is the dependent variable?
cues.zh: 首先，自變數與依變數是什麼？

cues.en: Well, the independent variables are all the variables from this one alcohol up to this one proline.
cues.zh: 自變數就是從 Alcohol 到 Proline 的所有變數。

cues.en: And this last variable customer segment, is the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 最後一個變數 Customer_Segment 是依變數。

cues.en: So in the original dataset, this dependent variable is not called customer segment.
cues.zh: 原始資料集中，這個依變數不叫 Customer_Segment。

cues.en: This is actually the origin of the wine.
cues.zh: 實際上代表葡萄酒的來源。

cues.en: But let's imagine that we as data scientists, are working for a wine business owner.
cues.zh: 但假設我們是為酒商工作的資料科學家。

cues.en: And this wine business owner gathered, all these informations in this dataset.
cues.zh: 酒商在這份資料集中收集了所有資訊。

cues.en: And so first, what this business owner did is that, it gathered all the informations of these independent variables here, that are chemicals informations of several wines.
cues.zh: 首先收集這些自變數資訊，也就是多種葡萄酒的化學資訊。

cues.en: And this business owner applied some clustering technique to find some segments of customers that like a specific wine depending on the informations of the wine.
cues.zh: 酒商套用某種分群技術，依酒的資訊，找出喜愛特定葡萄酒的顧客區隔。

cues.en: And by applying these clustering techniques, this business owner identified three segments of customers.
cues.zh: 透過分群，找出三個顧客區隔。

cues.en: That's the first one here.
cues.zh: 這裡是第一個。

cues.en: Then we have the second one, and eventually the third one.
cues.zh: 接著是第二個，最後是第三個。

cues.en: So based on these informations, and thanks to its clustering techniques, well this wine business owner, managed to find some segments of customers.
cues.zh: 根據這些資訊與分群技術，酒商成功找出顧客區隔。

cues.en: Each segment having a specific preference for a specific wine.
cues.zh: 每個區隔對特定葡萄酒有特定偏好。

cues.en: So basically this business owner found three types of wines, each type of wine corresponding to one segment of customers, and therefore three segments of customers.
cues.zh: 基本上，找到三種類型的酒，每種類型對應一個顧客區隔，因此共有三個區隔。

cues.en: And why does it create added value for his business?
cues.zh: 為什麼能為生意創造附加價值？

cues.en: Well, that's because now what this business owner can do is take all these informations of the wines, as well as the information about the customer segments and make a classification model like logistic regression,
cues.zh: 因為現在可以使用葡萄酒的所有資訊，以及顧客區隔資訊，建立分類模型，例如邏輯斯迴歸，

cues.en: in which the independent variables are all these variables, and the dependent variable is the customer segment.
cues.zh: 其中自變數是這些變數，依變數則是顧客區隔。

cues.en: And therefore, for each new wine, it can predict to which customer segment, it should recommend this wine.
cues.zh: 因此對每款新酒，都能預測應推薦給哪個顧客區隔。

cues.en: So that adds a lot of value for this business owner.
cues.zh: 這為酒商帶來很大價值。

cues.en: But then if this business owner wants to have a clear visual look at the prediction regions and the prediction boundary, of the classification model that we're going to build
cues.zh: 但如果酒商想清楚看到分類模型的預測區域與決策邊界，

cues.en: to be able to see if the predictions are in the right spot of the customer segments.
cues.zh: 確認預測是否落在正確的顧客區隔位置，

cues.en: Well, it cannot be done with all these independent variables because of course we cannot represent these many independent variables in one plot.
cues.zh: 就不能直接使用全部自變數，因為無法將這麼多自變數畫在一張圖。

cues.en: That's impossible.
cues.zh: 這不可能。

cues.en: So what we need to do is apply some dimensionality reduction techniques to extract two independent variables that explain the most, the variants and then we'll be able to see the prediction regions,
cues.zh: 所以需要降維技術，擷取出最能解釋變異的兩個自變數，才能看到預測區域

cues.en: and the prediction boundary.
cues.zh: 與決策邊界。

cues.en: And therefore we will clearly be able to see where the customer segments are and where these predictions of the customer segments are according to the extracted features
cues.zh: 因此就能根據從所有自變數資訊中擷取出的特徵，清楚看到顧客區隔的位置，

cues.en: of all the informations of our independent variables.
cues.zh: 以及這些區隔的預測位置。

cues.en: And remember, these extracted features are called the Principle components.
cues.zh: 記得，擷取出來的特徵稱為主成分。

cues.en: All right, so now that we understand the challenge and the business problem.
cues.zh: 好，現在理解了挑戰與商業問題。

cues.en: Let's apply PCA, to see how we can reduce the dimensionality of this data set because indeed it contains 13 dimensions, because it contains 13 independent variables.
cues.zh: 來套用 PCA，看看如何降低這份資料集的維度，它確實有 13 維，因為包含 13 個自變數。

cues.en: And we'll see how we can use PCA, to reduce this number of independent variables down to two independent variables, but be careful.
cues.zh: 看看如何使用 PCA，將自變數數量降為兩個，但要注意。

cues.en: It's important to understand that the new two independent variables that we'll have in the end are going to be new ones as opposed to feature selection where you know we end up with two independent variables
cues.zh: 必須理解，最後兩個自變數是新的，不同於特徵選取；特徵選取最後得到的兩個自變數，

cues.en: that are among these original 13 independent variables.
cues.zh: 原本就在這 13 個自變數裡。

cues.en: Here with PCA, we'll get new extracted one and that's the important distinction to make between feature selection and feature extraction.
cues.zh: 這裡的 PCA 則會擷取新的特徵，這是特徵選取與特徵擷取的重要差別。

cues.en: All right, so before we apply PCA, as usual we need to pre-process the data.
cues.zh: 套用 PCA 之前，和往常一樣，先前處理資料。

cues.en: And this is actually going to be very quick, because our template is ready.
cues.zh: 這會很快，因為範本已經準備好。

cues.en: We will just need to change just a few things.
cues.zh: 只需要修改少數地方。

cues.en: So first, data set equals data set three, five.
cues.zh: 首先是 dataset = dataset[c(3, 5)] 這一行。

cues.en: That's just to select the independent variables that matter for our problem.
cues.zh: 這只是選取與問題有關的自變數。

cues.en: But here, everything matters.
cues.zh: 但這裡所有特徵都有關。

cues.en: We just want to reduce the dimensionality of this data set.
cues.zh: 只想降低資料集維度。

cues.en: So we will keep all our independent variables here and therefore we don't need this line here.
cues.zh: 所以保留所有自變數，不需要這行。

cues.en: So I will just remove it.
cues.zh: 直接刪除。

cues.en: Okay, so first section in bringing the data set ready, well executed.
cues.zh: 好，第一段匯入資料集已準備好，也執行了。

cues.en: Now let's move on to the next section.
cues.zh: 進入下一段。

cues.en: So the next section is about splitting the data sets into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 下一段將資料集切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And here, be careful, we just need to change this name of the dependent variable, because in logistic regression, we're dealing with the social network ads CSV file,
cues.zh: 這裡注意，只需要修改依變數名稱。邏輯斯迴歸使用的是 Social_Network_Ads.csv，

cues.en: and the dependent variable was purchased.
cues.zh: 依變數叫 Purchased。

cues.en: But now for our new business problem, the dependent variable is not called purchased, it is called customer segment.
cues.zh: 現在新的商業問題，依變數不叫 Purchased，而是 Customer_Segment。

cues.en: So we just need to replace purchased here by customer segment.
cues.zh: 所以只要把這裡的 Purchased 換成 Customer_Segment。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: All right, do we keep a split ratio of 75%?
cues.zh: 切分比例要保留 75% 嗎？

cues.en: Well, let's rather take 80%, but that's as you want.
cues.zh: 我們改成 80%，但你可以自行決定。

cues.en: It's just that 80% is a good split ratio to take.
cues.zh: 只是 80% 是不錯的切分比例。

cues.en: So we will go with that.
cues.zh: 所以用它。

cues.en: And then here for training set and test set, we don't need to change anything.
cues.zh: 這裡的 training_set 和 test_set 不需要修改。

cues.en: So we are ready to split our data set into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 現在可以將資料集切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: I'm going to select all this section here and press command plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 選取這一整段，按 Command 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: The training set is now created as well as the test set.
cues.zh: 訓練集與測試集都建立了。

cues.en: Great, so ready to move on to the next section.
cues.zh: 很好，準備進入下一段。

cues.en: The next section is about feature scaling.
cues.zh: 下一段是特徵縮放。

cues.en: And for PCA, it is way better to apply feature scaling.
cues.zh: 對 PCA 而言，套用特徵縮放會好得多。

cues.en: You can actually apply it, by playing with the parameters of the PCA function that we're going to use afterwards.
cues.zh: 其實也可以透過稍後 PCA 函式的參數來做。

cues.en: But let's take this feature scaling part of our code template to put our features on the same scale.
cues.zh: 不過使用範本裡這段特徵縮放程式碼，讓特徵位於相同尺度。

cues.en: So here we just need to change the indexes.
cues.zh: 這裡只需要修改索引。

cues.en: We actually need to specify the indexes of the features we want to scale.
cues.zh: 需要指定哪些特徵的索引要進行縮放。

cues.en: So basically the features we want to scale are all the features from alcohol to proline.
cues.zh: 基本上，要縮放的是 Alcohol 到 Proline 的所有特徵。

cues.en: And so what we can do is specify this.
cues.zh: 所以可以這樣指定。

cues.en: We want to scale all the variables except the last one customer segment that has index 14.
cues.zh: 除了最後一個、索引為 14 的 Customer_Segment，其餘變數都縮放。

cues.en: So therefore, here instead of putting the indexes of the features, we can replace it by minus 14.
cues.zh: 因此這裡可以不用列出特徵索引，而是換成 -14。

cues.en: We can remove that.
cues.zh: 刪掉這段。

cues.en: Let's copy this, because we will, do the same for the others.
cues.zh: 複製這個，因為其他地方也要一樣處理。

cues.en: So let's replace that here by minus 14 and minus 14 here as well, and eventually minus 14.
cues.zh: 這裡換成 -14，這裡也是 -14，最後這裡也設為 -14。

cues.en: All right, so now the feature scaling part is ready.
cues.zh: 好，特徵縮放部分準備好了。

cues.en: So we are ready to select the section and press command control plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 選取這段，按 Command 或 Control 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: And now all our variables are scaled.
cues.zh: 現在所有特徵都已縮放。

cues.en: As you can see, we can clearly see that all our features are on the same scale.
cues.zh: 可以清楚看到，所有特徵都在相同尺度。

cues.en: And of course, the customer segments kept its labels, one, two, and three.
cues.zh: 當然，顧客區隔保留 1、2、3 這些標籤。

cues.en: And same for the test set.
cues.zh: 測試集也一樣。

cues.en: Let's make sure that's, all right, perfect.
cues.zh: 確認一下，好，完全正確。

cues.en: So feature scaling done and actually the pre-processing phase is completed.
cues.zh: 特徵縮放完成，資料前處理階段也完成了。

cues.en: So we did that quite efficiently.
cues.zh: 做得很有效率。

cues.en: But that's good because now we're getting to the exciting part, applying PCA to our data.
cues.zh: 這很好，因為現在要進入精彩部分，對資料套用 PCA。

cues.en: So actually we will do that right here.
cues.zh: 就在這裡進行。

cues.en: You apply PCA right after the data pre-processing phase and just before you fit your logistic regression model to the training set, because of course, you want to train your model on your new data sets
cues.zh: PCA 應緊接資料前處理之後、將邏輯斯迴歸擬合到訓練集之前套用，因為當然要用包含新擷取特徵的

cues.en: with the new extracted features.
cues.zh: 新資料集來訓練模型。

cues.en: That is with the two new extracted features that will explain the most variance.
cues.zh: 也就是最能解釋變異的兩個新擷取特徵。

cues.en: And after you trained your class fire you're ready to predict the tested results make the confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 訓練分類器後，就能預測測試集結果，建立混淆矩陣。

cues.en: Then you can also visualize the training set results.
cues.zh: 接著也可以視覺化訓練集結果。
